# Synthetic XML test data

The repository does not store user-owned `.loredit` sequences or `.lorprev`
display exports. Sequence templates and larger preview examples are generated
at test time by `tests/fixture_builders.py` using fictional names, identifiers,
controller addresses, and geometry.

The only static preview is `synthetic_display.lorprev`, a tiny hand-authored
fixture containing fictional props and coordinates. Do not add customer or
owner show files, previews, audio, media, local paths, or secrets here.
